author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at this Extended Reveal Trailer for Artificial Detective, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by VIVIX Inc. Players will embody a robodetective named AD 2846 on the case in a dystopian city lacking humanity after their mysterious disappearance. Embark on a mystery of a lifetime to fight, hack, and outwit the opposition of rogue robots to seek the truth behind humanity's whereabouts. Artificial Detective is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Artificial Detective - Official Extended Reveal Trailer

Albion Online launches on April 21 for Xbox Series X|S, with the game also available now on iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, and PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out action-packed gameplay from Exodus in this new video for the upcoming sci-fi RPG. Take a look at Khonsu, a Celestial-built defense platform orbiting your homeworld on Lidon. The new Exodus gameplay clip showcases close-range combat within Khonsu's interior corridors with companions Tom and Elise. We also get to see the Recycler in action, with Repeater mode for ranged encounters and Shredder mode for when enemies close the gap. Additionally, check out the Lance gauntlet ability, which hurls livestone javelins for heavy damage and get a look at Ghosts, ancient Celestial automated defenses that wake up when they detect intruders. 

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.​
title: Exodus - Official 'Breaching Khonsu' Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Duet Night Abyss trailer for the RPG to see what's coming with The Firmament Unbound update, which marks the end of the game's Huaxu storyline and will feature a climactic confrontation with Lord Argent. The Firmament Unbound update also features two new characters: Su Yi, who fights with custom mechs and a shotgun, and Camilla, who steps in to battle with her “Dregs of Glimmer" assault rifle. The update also includes five new regions to explore, a new flying sword mount, and new bosses: Terracolossus and the dual Loong bosses, Taihao and Zhuyin.

Duet Night Abyss' The Firmament Unbound update launches on mobile and PC on April 7, 2026.
title: Duet Night Abyss - Official 'The Firmament Unbound' Update Trailer

description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Slime Rancher Mobile, a mobile version of the hit space ranching first-person game developed by Monomi Park. title: Slime Rancher Mobile - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Reclaim! Azhe-giiwewining is available now on Steam and itch.io for PC and Mac. Watch the Reclaim! Azhe-giiwewining launch trailer for this cultural point-and-click adventure game from Grassroots Indigenous Multimedia (GIM), an organization led by Indigenous creatives and language specialists. Reclaim! Azhe-giiwewining is an interactive "visual love letter" to the Ojibwe (Ojibwemowin) language and culture. Designed collaboratively with Ojibwe community members and language activists, the game seeks to contribute to a growing language revitalization movement and make learning Ojibwemowin an accessible, authentic experience.
title: Reclaim! Azhe-giiwewining - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the announcement trailer for Tour de France 2026 and Pro Cycling Manager 26. Tour de France 2026 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on June 4, 2026. Pro Cycling Manager 26 will be available on PC on June 4, 2026.

Tour de France 2026 faithfully reproduces the 21 new stages of the Grand Tour, including iconic locations such as the Sagrada Familia in Barcelona, the starting city of this new edition, and the Basilica of Sacré-Cœur de Montmartre in Paris. You can embody most of the season's riders, such as Tadej Pogačar or Remco Evenepoel, with their official jerseys and teams.

Tour de France 2026 uses Unreal Engine 5, and will feature changing weather conditions during races. It will also feature three game modes: 2 single-player modes to choose between embodying your own cyclist or a team of riders, and an online multiplayer mode for 6 players. 

Pro Cycling Manager 26 allows you to take on the role of a sports director, where every decision will im
title: Tour de France 2026 and Pro Cycling Manager 26 - Official Announcement Trailer
